construction: the record is 40 bytes long: the first 40 bytes of the original block, with byte 0x00 (the first magic byte) flipped

quotes: With supplied values, the Scanner judges the first record in two stages: the physical read first and then, for a record of the right length, its content.
a record whose measured length differs from the supplied block size, shorter or longer | refuses it (`BootstrapParse`, naming the block size)
For a record of the right length, the first matching row applies:

A Reader treats it as invalid content of the component it belongs to: an invalid candidate for a control component, an erasure when the Recoverer reads a data block or parity shard (Section 13.4), and, for the first record with a supplied or known block size, the refusal of Sections 8.4 and 15.
